use: The district identifies the standing double fortification and the Great Mosque inside it.
Protected fort and mosque are identified together; the complex is distinct from the surrounding historical mansions and religious sites.
British Library catalogues the Deen Dayal Great Mosque photograph in the original 1892 presentation album.
British Library catalogues the Deen Dayal photograph of the fort and moat.
The original published two-photo plate describes the different levels of the western approaches and ramparts.
